full_name: Melani McAlister | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Humanities Maury Green Fellow George Washington University
bio: Melani McAlister is a professor of American studies and international affairs at the George Washington University whose work has focused primarily on the cultural histories of the United States in the world, examining the multiple vectors of American power along with resistance and challenges to that power.
